source_caption_text:
Cardi B is still helping clean her grandparents house back in the Dominican Republic 🙏❤️

Her father just posted this video on his TikTok account papabardi 

Cardi B has built one of the biggest careers in modern rap. Her 2018 debut album Invasion of Privacy debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, won Best Rap Album at the Grammys and made her the first solo woman to take home the award. The album also produced hits like “Bodak Yellow” and “I Like It,” both of which reached No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

She continued making history with Am I the Drama?, becoming the first female rapper to have her first two studio albums debut at No. 1. But during a visit back to the Dominican Republic, Cardi was seen helping clean her grandparents’ home a heartfelt reminder that even after all the success, family and her roots still matter to her. ❤️🙏
